2026-11-12: outside a song over 30 fps the tasks' whole logic step (0x4C0F4: new tasks, Init, Ctrl, Dest) runs only on 30 Hz ticks, with the game speed at 1.0; Basic and Disp still run every frame. Before, only the Ctrl pass waited (0x4C2CC) and the other passes ran ahead of it: the task that starts a song read the chosen song (block at *0xBFAC34, +0x10) before the song select's Ctrl had written it, and the game started with no song (white screen). Never true with fps_target=30 or in a song.

It is a state machine, nothing animates from it.
